finding: Slovak firms face margin compression as input costs outpace selling price expectations
bullets: Slovak firms (n=397) expected production input prices to rise 7.91% over the next 12 months, outpacing selling price expectations of 5.29% (n=394), pointing to margin compression.
Average selling price expectations rose from +3.75% (wave 39) to +5.29% (wave 40) for Slovak firms, remaining below the EA's +7.15% (n=11,832).

Slovak firms anticipated 5.00% wage growth (n=398), above the EA's 4.76%, while 12-month inflation expectations held at +4.87% (n=164), rising only marginally by 0.19 pp versus the EA's 2.28 pp jump to +6.16%.
chart_subtitle: Slovak firms expect 5.29% selling price rise, below EA 7.15%.
